First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
A/B/C pace groups; C group stays together, A and B are drop rides. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pgh Babes on Bikes Frigid Witch Training Rides group ride

Pgh Babes on Bikes Frigid Witch Training Rides is a road group ride in Pittsburgh, PA. It rolls every Sunday at 1:00 pm from Two Frays Brewing. It’s on its seasonal break now.

Winter training rides for women and underrepresented genders ahead of the Frigid Witch ride on Valentine’s Day. Pace groups exist because volunteers lead them. Snacks, coffee and merch at the brewery.
